image_description: A close-up underwater photograph of a lionfish (Pterois) swimming against a solid blue background. The fish displays characteristic red and white vertical stripes, large fan-like pectoral fins with elongated rays, and prominent dorsal spines. A watermark is visible in the bottom right corner.
